commands:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin
export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
WORK="$(mktemp -d /tmp/bloomml-ipo-hwq.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
git clone --quiet --branch main https://github.com/MichalMatu/bloomml.git "$WORK/source"
cd "$WORK/source"
EXPECTED="1a1b3de8dada926a00f37be158ef99cd1393b860"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"
echo "SOURCE_SHA|$EXPECTED"
echo "MAC_TOOLCHAIN|$(uname -m)"
echo "BOARD_BUILD_FLAGS|$(rg -n 'REAL_OUTPUTS|REAL_INPUT|fake.lock|THERMAL_TEST' Makefile sdkconfig.defaults* CMakeLists.txt src/climate/runtime/RuntimeBuildConfig.h 2>/dev/null | head -60 || true)"
if command -v idf.py >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "IDF_COMMAND|available"; else echo "IDF_COMMAND|not-on-path"; fi
if command -v pio >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "PIO_COMMAND|available"; else echo "PIO_COMMAND|not-on-path"; fi
make build-crowpanel
echo "CROWPANEL_EXACT_SHA_BUILD|PASS"
git diff --check
echo "GIT_DIFF_CHECK|PASS"
echo "WORKTREE|$(git status --porcelain | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
